source.note: Third-party reconstruction of the official set design; not LEGO-authored CAD. Only explicitly licensed source sections redistributed. Source model omits stickers.

recipe.adaptation: Extracted unchanged source subassembly; source placements outside selectedOrdinals are excluded, not silently substituted.
